nuggets.text: Cardinals QB Keldric Luster is listed at 5-foot-10 and 250 pounds, a build that made him an internet sensation.
Keldric Luster cites Kyler Murray, another undersized Texas quarterback, as his inspiration.
Brody Boehm drilled a 54-yard field goal at Ohio State for the Cardinals' only points in the opener.
The Cardinals have not lost to an FCS opponent since Indiana State in 2014.
Ball State's football program began in 1924 as the Muncie Normal Hoosieroons.
The Cardinals and Northern Illinois play for the Bronze Stalk Trophy, which depicts cornstalks.
The Cardinals won their first sanctioned bowl game in the 2020 Arizona Bowl, beating San Jose State 34-13.
David Letterman, a Ball State alum, jokingly campaigned on his TV show to have the Cardinals' stadium named after him.
The Cardinals make their Cardinal Walk with fans exactly two hours and 15 minutes before every home kickoff.
Cardinals coach Mike Uremovich was born in Gary, Indiana, and earned his bachelor's degree at Purdue.
